source_text: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) 2014 recommendations, informed by meta-analyses, advised providers counsel parents on newborn circumcision's net benefits for HIV prevention (50-60% reduction in acquisition risk per randomized trials in adults, extrapolated to infants) and other outcomes like balanitis avoidance, emphasizing informed consent amid cultural/religious contexts while noting low absolute risks in sterile settings. [151] [152]
